title: QuillVille Community Picks
description: A curated catalogue of stations, podcasts and places that Quill Radio and QUILL Cast offer from their Community menu. Served from https://quillforall.org/picks/v1/picks.json and rebuilt whenever a suggestion is approved. See docs/design/community-picks.md.

format.description: Refuses a file that is valid JSON but not this document.

version.description: Diagnostics only. Breaking changes move the URL to /v2/, so a v1 client keeps reading a file that still means what it meant.

updated.description: When the catalogue was last rebuilt.

collections.description: Groups shown as separate sections in the picker.

id.description: Stable and forever. It is how 'already added' is detected, so renaming a station must not make it a different pick.

type.description: A client MUST ignore an item whose type it does not understand, and skip it silently. That is what lets a new type ship without breaking Radio 3.0. The listed values are today's; the constraint is deliberately open.

description.description: The publisher's or the curator's words. Never generated: this is what somebody chooses from.

node_id.description: A browse node id. Required when type is place.

apps.description: Which apps may offer this. Absent means all of them, so Cast is never handed a radio stream it cannot play.

added.description: So the picker can say '3 new since you last looked'.

retired.description: Stop OFFERING this pick. It disappears from the picker and NOTHING a user already added is touched: their favorite stays, their subscription stays. Taking something out of a shop window is not the same as reaching into somebody's house.

httpsUrl.description: HTTPS only. A catalogue that can point the app at plain HTTP is a catalogue that can be rewritten in transit.
